request.prompt:

One broad silver SWORD with emerald hilt in anatomical RIGHT hand, LEFT gauntlet empty. Tall athletic imposing silhouette, no bird wings on back or princess gown; keep red hair/winged helmet/green armor.
Fixed camera throughout this sheet: SOUTH straight FRONT facing DOWN toward viewer. Anatomical RIGHT weapon hand is viewerLEFT, LEFT empty hand viewerRIGHT.
Action RUN: Six clear locomotion poses in order: phase0 RIGHT leg contact, phase1 RIGHT leg compresses/LEFT free leg swings, phase2 RIGHT toeoff/LEFT knee drives, phase3 LEFT leg contact/RIGHT leg lifts, phase4 LEFT leg compresses/RIGHT free leg swings, phase5 LEFT toeoff/RIGHT knee drives. Exactly ONE anatomical RIGHT-held weapon throughout if the character uses one; never hand swap or duplicate. Left hand stays free. Natural head recoil is fine without changing the overall facing.
Layout EXACTLY SIX COMPLETE distinct animation poses in TWO COLUMNS and THREE ROWS (2x3), read row-major 0,1 / 2,3 / 4,5, WIDE LANDSCAPE transparent canvas. Keep each figure body about200px high with identical scale. No pose or weapon intersects another; no anatomy reaches canvas edge. No floor/shadow/effects/text. Preserve character identity and action sequence. Not flipped, no mirrored anatomy.
